summary: Readers map the store file instead of reading each page with read(). After any commit SQLite empties every reader's page cache, so each request fetched again every page it touched, one read() call each (87,500 a second on dev3, #3343). SMALLCLAIMS_READ_MMAP_MIB caps the mapping; 0 turns it off.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Query results are unchanged. Daemon RSS now includes the mapped store pages it touched, which are file-backed and reclaimable.

downtime.detail: A daemon restart to install the build; no extra interruption.

manual.detail: Nothing to configure. SMALLCLAIMS_READ_MMAP_MIB=0 in the daemon's environment restores read() for every page.

recovery.detail: Swap back to the previous binary freely, or set SMALLCLAIMS_READ_MMAP_MIB=0; nothing is persisted.
